sample_unit: clinical cases (each queried 3 times with 3 questions)

links.outcome: LLM accuracy and completeness on textbook laboratory medicine cases, by question type
links.effect: Overall accuracy 72.9% (95% CI 69.9-75.7%) and completeness 73.4%; differential diagnosis accuracy only 55.0% versus 85.7% for diagnostic hypotheses.
links.quote: Performance varied by question type: the highest accuracy was observed for diagnostic hypotheses (85.7%, 95% CI [81.2%, 89.2%]) and the lowest for differential diagnoses (55.0%, 95% CI [49.3%, 60.5%]).

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance of DeepSeek-R1 across 100 clinical laboratory vignettes scored by senior physicians without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
